visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair, wearing a light yellow knit top and patterned shorts, holds a large bright pink box labeled 'PINK OFFICE' in a brightly lit indoor setting. She smiles brightly and looks directly at the camera. (2) She opens the box to reveal a structured arrangement of cosmetic products, including several circular blush containers and various tubes of lip tints, all neatly organized in white protective packaging. (3) The scene shifts to a close-up of her hand holding a spherical, translucent pink blush container, followed by her applying the product to her cheek using her fingers, highlighting her glowing complexion. (4) A series of quick cuts shows her applying different shades of lip tints to her lips, holding the specific product tubes labeled with shade numbers like #02, #03, and #14 close to her face. (5) In the final phase, she holds up several products and smiles enthusiastically at the camera, gesturing with the items while standing in front of a neutral-toned wall with soft lighting.
